title: PNT-Edge: Towards Robust Edge Detection with Noisy Labels by Learning Pixel-level Noise Transitions
mechanism: Models label corruption as a smooth displacement field. A 4-layer FCN takes the image, confident predictions and the noisy label, and warps the detector output onto the noisy label, so the detector itself fits the clean, aligned edges.
adaptation: Warm up the house model only until the val crack metric saturates (the memorization point). Then train jointly with the warp module on the crack channel, max shift 3 px. Drop or replace the local-edge-density prior with ridge strength, because cracks are sparse. The warp absorbs per-source and per-annotator offsets, and the detector learns ridge-centred cracks.
min_experiment: Arm: house warm-up + PSL joint training, 5 seeds. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2, E1 relF1@2. Kill if crack IoU and relF1@2 are both n.d. (< 0.012 and < 0.01).
evidence: R: gains over CASENet-S and SEAL on SBD and Cityscapes, scored on a re-annotated clean SBD subset. Shows the memorization effect: clean-label metrics saturate early, then the model memorizes noise. Losses: MSE on confident shifts, warp similarity, smoothness, unmatched-pixel suppression.
prior_overlap: Partly overlaps offset-tolerant CE (n.d.). A learned smooth displacement field with suppression of unmatched pixels is a different mechanism. Noisy-label methods are listed as never tried. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Warm up the house model until val crack metric on revised labels saturates, then joint training with a crack-only warp (max shift 3 px), ridge strength replacing the edge-density prior. Detector learns ridge-centred cracks; warp absorbs per-source offsets.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: warm-up + PSL joint training, 5 seeds; baseline house 5 seeds. Metrics crack IoU, relF1@2, E1 relF1@2. Kill if crack IoU and relF1@2 both n.d. About 15 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add a 2-channel flow head on the U-Net++ decoder bounded to +/-3 px, applied only to crack (and inactive boundary) channels, with smoothness along the crack in place of the edge-density term; infer with the unwarped head.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + bounded flow head on crack. Baseline: house. Metric: strict crack IoU, relF1@2, component recall >= 20 px. Kill if strict IoU < house and relF1@2 not up by >= 0.01. About 6 GPU-h plus 2 days code.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack only, max shift 3 px, after warm-up on the house recipe; condition the shift network on a source one-hot so it learns per-source bias (BMRK worst, 38% within 1 px). Report mean learned shift per source as a label-quality number for the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house warm-up + PSL warp training, 5 seeds; baseline: house. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2 on clean-49, E1 relF1@2. Kill if both n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add a 2-channel shift head conditioned on source ID, displacement capped at 2 px with smoothness, applied to the crack channel before CE + Dice; predict unwarped. The source conditioning lets it learn each source's offset and width.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + source-conditioned shift head, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and relF1@2. Kill: crack IoU under +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Make the shift head source-conditioned (FiLM on source ID) and apply it to the crack channel only. Use the warped output for strict IoU against source labels and the unwarped output for relF1@2 and severity length estimates. Run only if per-source label-to-ridge offset is systematic.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Pre-check (no GPU): per-source signed offset of label skeleton to darkest ridge in x and y on train labels; proceed only if any source mean > 0.3 px. Arm: house PF + source-conditioned shift head, 5 seeds vs house PF; metric clean-49 crack IoU; kill if < +0.012.
